important: NO CEnT-S official syllabus was provided among the sources, so shared-candidate selection is provisional and based on general transferability (quantitative reasoning, logic, reading). It MUST be re-validated against the real CEnT-S structure before any CEnT-S export. No CEnT-S bank is produced now (per instruction).
selectionModel: As of bank v1.3, shared-candidate status is carried ON EACH QUESTION in til_i_official_bank.json via the boolean field `sharedCandidate: true` and the tag `shared_candidate_cents_s`. This file no longer enumerates every candidate; query the bank by that flag. Counts below are a snapshot.
isolationRules: A shared question is copied into CEnT-S as a SEPARATE record with examProfile='CENTS_S' and a distinct id (e.g. cents_s_...).
Asset names are duplicated distinctly: til_i_<...>.png vs cents_s_<...>.png — never shared.
TIL-I and CEnT-S never coexist in the same bank/file.

tier1_strong.reason: Exam-agnostic deductive/verbal reasoning; transferable to almost any aptitude test IF CEnT-S has logic/reading sections. Reading passages must travel with their questions.

tier2_quantitative.reason: Word-problem / general-arithmetic math items are broadly transferable; symbol-heavy algebra/trig items are less so. Filter within mathematics by questionType=word_problem for the strongest subset.

tier3_provisional_engineering.reason: Engineering-specific. Flagged sharedCandidate by the extractor on general-reasoning grounds, but physics/CS/representation overlap with CEnT-S is UNCONFIRMED and likely low. Do NOT export these until the CEnT-S syllabus proves overlap.

notSharedRationale: Chemistry does not exist in TIL-I. TIL-I Representation and Computer-Science items are engineering/Politecnico-specific; physics is discipline-specific. All three are held in tier-3 (provisional) and are NOT recommended for CEnT-S until its syllabus confirms overlap.
nextStep: Obtain the official CEnT-S structure/syllabus, then: (1) keep tier-1 + the word-problem subset of tier-2 as the initial shared pool, (2) re-tag tier-3 per real overlap, (3) generate cents_s_* records with fresh ids/assets.
